items.title: Joe Muranyi interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 11, 2007
items.q: But she told me some stories about Jimmie Rodgers, you know the country singer?

ctx.x: You know, like button lacquer or something. But she told me some stories about Jimmie Rodgers, you know the country singer? And how much of a junkie he was you know. Some of his records were made in hotel rooms with people holding him up by the side.
